{{Quote|&hellip;so while I've been slugging it out on Queel against the droids, you've been podracing?|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Anakin Skywalker, after the latter completed his mission on Mon Gazza|<ref name="Crash Course" />}}
A '''battle''' occurred around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Queel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Republic forces&mdash;led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;tried to liberate Queel from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Confederate Droid Army]]. Due in part to the efforts of Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the Republic managed to destroy the Separatist [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] position on Queel, clearing the way for an attack on the [[Queel Confederate base|enemy command base]]. Skywalker and Tano, however, were then recalled from Queel to a [[Mission to Mon Gazza|mission]] on the planet [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], leaving Kenobi to continue the battle.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Your Padawan is as subtle as you are, Anakin.''"<br />"''You can't argue with results.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, concerning Ahsoka Tano's destruction of the Confederate artillery position|<ref name="Crash Course" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Crash Course" /> in the early months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] struggled to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Queel]] from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led a group of Republic [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platforms]] in an engagement with several Confederate [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]].<ref name="Crash Course" />

At the same time, Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;riding a large [[Queel water dragon|native aquatic creature]]&mdash;was conducting her own mission. Together with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]&mdash;nicknamed "Rex"&mdash;and several other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Tano attacked the Separatists' [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] position that was preventing the Republic from a direct assault on the planet's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Queel Confederate base|command base]]. Using his two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|blaster pistols]], Rex destroyed several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that were operating one of the artillery guns, while Tano destroyed the gun itself and a [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]] with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Tano then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] one of the artillery shells at the remaining guns, and Rex placed a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot on the shell, triggering an explosion that destroyed the entire artillery position. With her objective complete, Tano regrouped with Skywalker and Kenobi.<ref name="Crash Course" />

[[File:YodaMundi_contact_Queel.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Skywalker, Kenobi, Tano and Rex receive a transmission from Yoda and Ki-Adi-Mundi.]]
The destruction of the artillery battery cleared the path for an attack on the Confederate command center. However, before any attack could be made, Skywalker and Kenobi were contacted by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], who informed them of an urgent message from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Rex returned to [[Queel Republic forward command post|their forward command post]] and received the transmission inside one of the [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] informed them that a [[Messo|Separatist agent]] had stolen a [[Datachip/Legends|data file]] containing information vital to the Republic and was going to hand it over to the Confederacy on the planet [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. To this end, Yoda and Mundi ordered Skywalker to go to Mon Gazza and retrieve the data file. Soon Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], set off for Mon Gazza, leaving Kenobi to continue the fight on Queel.<ref name="Crash Course" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Queel first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novel]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]'', written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Gary Scheppke]], illustrated by [[Fillbach Brothers]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Crash Course" /> on [[December 31]], [[2008]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-831/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars--Crash-Course|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars--Crash Course}}</ref>
